# Reads in all participant demos from prolific

```{r}
read_all_subfolders <- function(dir_path, file_pattern = "\\.csv$") {
  files <- list.files(
    path = dir_path,
    pattern = file_pattern,
    full.names = TRUE,
    recursive = TRUE
  )

  dfs <- lapply(files, function(f) {
    df <- read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df$Experiment <- basename(dirname(f))
    df
  })

  do.call(rbind, dfs)
}
# Call it
combined_df <- read_all_subfolders("../data/", file_pattern = "\\.csv$")
```


```{r}
nrow(combined_df)
length(unique(combined_df$Participant.id))

# Remove RETURNED stat
d <- combined_df %>% 
  filter(Status == "APPROVED")

nrow(d)
length(unique(d$Participant.id))
```

# Age

```{r}
d$Age <- as.numeric(d$Age)
range(d$Age)

summary(d$Age)

median(d$Age)
IQR(d$Age)
sd(d$Age)
```

```{r}
# Calculate statistics
age_mean <- mean(d$Age)
age_median <- median(d$Age)
age_mode <- d$Age[which.max(table(d$Age))]  # or use a mode function

# Find max density for y-position
dens <- density(d$Age)
y_max <- max(dens$y)
x_max <- max(dens$x)

ggplot(d, aes(x = Age)) + 
  geom_density() +
  
  # Mean line (blue)
  geom_vline(xintercept = age_mean,
             color = "blue", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Median line (red)
  geom_vline(xintercept = age_median,
             color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Mode line (green)
  geom_vline(xintercept = age_mode,
             color = "green", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +

    # Labels at top right
  annotate("text", x = x_max, y = y_max,
           label = paste0("Mean = ", round(age_mean, 1)),
           color = "blue", size = 4, hjust = 4, vjust = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = x_max, y = y_max,
           label = paste0("Median = ", round(age_median, 1)),
           color = "red", size = 4, hjust = 4.05, vjust = 2.5) +
  annotate("text", x = x_max, y = y_max,
           label = paste0("Mode = ", round(age_mode, 1)),
           color = "green", size = 4, hjust = 4.7, vjust = 1)
```


```{r}

ggplot(d, aes(x=Age)) + 
  geom_histogram() +
  facet_wrap(~Experiment)

ggplot(d, aes(x=Age)) + 
  geom_density() +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=mean(Age)),
            color="blue", linetype="dashed", linewidth=1) +
  facet_wrap(~Experiment)
```
